key.name: clock-position
key.summary: Clock position: default (stock, centred), center-top, bottom-left

key.name: margin-x
key.summary: bottom-left: distance from the left edge, px

key.name: margin-y
key.summary: center-top: distance from the top; bottom-left: from the bottom, px

key.name: clock-font-size
key.summary: Time font size in px (0 = stock)

key.name: date-font-size
key.summary: Date font size in px (0 = stock)

key.name: clock-font-family
key.summary: Font family for time and date (empty = stock)

key.name: clock-font-weight
key.summary: CSS font-weight for the time, e.g. 200 or bold (empty = stock)

key.name: clock-glow
key.summary: CSS colour of a soft glow (text-shadow) around the time (empty = none)

key.name: clock-color
key.summary: CSS colour of the time (empty = stock)

key.name: date-color
key.summary: CSS colour of the date (empty = stock)

key.name: hide-hint
key.summary: Hide the "Click or press a key" hint

key.name: prompt-offset
key.summary: Shift the password prompt down (px, may be negative)

key.name: tint
key.summary: CSS colour laid over the background, e.g. rgba(90,40,160,0.35) (empty = none)

key.name: background-uri
key.summary: file:// image for the lock screen (empty = desktop wallpaper, as stock GNOME 51; the word screensaver = org.gnome.desktop.screensaver picture-uri)
